newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill infiltrator from Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill infiltrator from Jordan.

text.p: Israeli troops shot and killed a man who infiltrated Israel from Jordan on Saturday, Israeli security sources said.
They said according to initial reports, the incident occurred near the Israeli village of Kfar Rupin, just north of the border between Israel and the West Bank.
Anti-Israel guerrillas periodically attempt to cross from Jordan into Israel and the occupied West Bank, which Israel seized from Jordan in 1967, to mount attacks.

But Jordan, which cooperated quietly with Israel even when the two states were publicly enemies, has kept tight control of the Jordan Valley area since it signed a peace treaty with the Jewish state in 1994.
